2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch breaks out the gup_lookup_pte() helper from follow_page_pte(). The new function resolves a present PTE to the page it maps, returning no error if the PTE cannot be followed but the caller may fault it in. It returns a negative errno when the caller must report the failure. This change is intended to improve code organization and maintainability without introducing any functional changes.
